clause.quote: Likewise, this means that the length of any Primitive in the ‘T’ domain MUST be an integer multiple of four Base64 characters with a minimum length of four Base64 characters.

description: A -J group holding one D key, with the last two bytes of the stream removed, so the key is 42 characters, not a whole number of quadlets. The specification has no sentence saying such a stream must be rejected; the assertion rests on the cited MUST, which this stream violates, so it cannot be decoded as a conforming stream. Any rejection satisfies the assertion; the class in the note is informative.
title: Reject a stream that ends inside a primitive
